kind: release prerequisite, not a roadmap feature

contract.scope: Private unmapped framework release build only; public compile, examples, declarations and mapped builds retain exact output
contract.preserved: Every token, newline, runtime literal byte and comment/license
contract.fallback: Entire original module on ambiguous lexical ownership, escaped identifiers, nested Unicode-v character classes or template depth over 64
contract.compatibility: Rebuilt columns/digests and Function.toString formatting can change; use identical compatible definitions across worker fleets; stored artifacts remain immutable
contract.rollback: Prior immutable compatible distribution and data snapshot; no data reformat
contract.recursiveWatch: Persistent recursive watch error handling and serialized 1-second filename reconciliation; ENOENT during directory moves cannot crash the CLI or leave stale output. No content polling or dependency.

retainedFailures.proof: Source01 Node26 full gate passed; Node22 failed four tests because every temporary build included a 258-level fixture which crashes the minimum native parser before the release pass
retainedFailures.resolution: Keep full failed evidence, probe every fixture and parser depths/modes. Use stricter scanner depth64 with a depth66 fixture accepted by both runtimes, preserving the same fallback assertion. Source02 archive is a checkpoint, not a claimed complete gate.

retainedFailures.setup: The initial SSH channel ended with 255 while its known remote gate driver continued; retained exit files and full output establish Node26 pass and Node22 failure. A broad full-text query did not rank the guide in its first five results.
retainedFailures.resolution: Do not overlap full gates or infer success from transport. Wait for actual remote completion; use a distinctive word from the current guide for actual search and retain the unsuccessful setup log.

retainedFailures.proof: Final source03 hosted conformance failed existing directory-deletion watch test. Minimum Node22 repeated reproduction failed at attempt six; instrumented stderr identified native recursive watcher ENOENT and unhandled error killing the process. Filename polling alone also failed because the watcher still crashed.
retainedFailures.resolution: Use persistent callback watcher error handling plus bounded filename reconciliation through the existing serialized build queue. Final real ENOENT/dropped-event regression and both complete Node26/22 gates pass; no skip or CI rerun substituted for repair.
